rv.q: Stephen Adly Guirgis has written a blazingly authentic urban drama that crackles with profane poetry and pulsates with raw emotion.
Mr. Guirgis has created a work that pulses with the rhythm of real life and real pain, even when it occasionally stumbles over its own good intentions.
At some point, the vulgar street talk fades; and what emerges is a warm and genuine experience that makes you feel as though you’re walking on air as you leave the theater.

cn.t: Guirgis's profane urban drama pulses with raw emotion and authentic street poetry, earning mostly positive reviews despite occasional stumbles in execution.
